title: Associate Industrial Designer (Fastening)
note: Entry-level ID role on the Fastening tools category, separate from Milwaukee's 2027 new-grad associate program; portfolio required.

facts.summary: Entry-level industrial designer supporting Milwaukee Tool's Fastening category with mentorship.
facts.duties: User research, concept ideation, sketching, 3D modeling, prototyping and testing, DfM support, presentations and design documentation through production.
facts.requirements: Bachelor's in Industrial Design or equivalent; portfolio showing form development and problem solving; grasp of ergonomics, usability and manufacturing.
facts.apply: Apply on Milwaukee Tool's Workday careers site with a portfolio.
